{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the count of -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id entries
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Show the first few rows with -999
print("\nFirst few rows with -999 in biomarker_baseline:")
print(data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].head())

# Show how many times each patient_id appears
print("\nPatient_id frequency count:")
print(data['patient_id'].value_counts().value_counts())"}
